intro: Lieutenant Lisande is an emissary of the Argent Dawn stationed upon the high mesas of Thunder Bluff. As a human operating openly in tauren lands, she serves as a liaison against the shared existential threat of the Scourge.

p: While human faces are rare across the windblown heights of Thunder Bluff, the Argent Dawn transcends traditional faction enmities. Lieutenant Lisande serves the holy order by watching for signs of the Lich King's taint even in remote Kalimdor. When undead forces stir on the plains below, she rallies brave Horde champions to ride out and investigate the encroaching menace before it can defile the sacred earth.
